entities.summary: Olga Paredes, also known by the pseudonym Caleidoscopic, is a Bolivian architect and Wikipedia editor. She was named Wikimedian of the Year during Wikimania 2022 by Wikipedia co-founder Jimmy Wales. She was the first person from Bolivia to receive this award.
